text:
packet-22 - unverified image reading (blind; no identification seen in context)

LAYOUT SURVEY (from overviews image-001, -011, -021, -031)

General: four paper leaves (two bifolium-halves?) photographed in pairs, each pair on black ground with colour chart and mm scale. Pencil modern shelf labels visible on the leaves: "Stams, STA, Frg. 178-2r" / "-1r" (image-001), "-2v" / "-1v" (image-011), "-4r" / "-3r" (image-021), "-4v" / "-3v" (image-031). Grey redaction boxes cover areas on several faces (probably modern labels). Script: German cursive (Kurrent) in brown ink, single column, account-book layout: entries at left, amounts at right (fl. / k(reuzer) / f(?) or Mutt/Yhre for grain), long horizontal strokes leading to the amount column, "Suma" lines with large flourished S initials, large looped initials at entry openings. No glosses; no rubrication visible (all one brown ink). Fold creases with tape repairs; leaves 1 and 2 were cut to octagonal shape and outer margins folded / pasted (binding waste, turn-ins visible on versos).

image-001: left = 2r, right = 1r.
  2r: upper part of page, entries with amounts; "Suma" line mid-page; entries beginning "Item"/"Mer"; date "1538 Jar" visible at left; damaged/taped lower margin.
  1r: top cropped; heading at top right partly lost (ends "...ferg"?), folio number "92"? at top right corner; entries with "Suma" lines (x2); text in lower part breaks off under redaction box.
image-011: left = 2v, right = 1v. Both faces largely blank in the central area, which is pasted/translucent (showing offset/show-through of rectos). Turn-in margins carry a few words: on 1v vertical writing along right margin, and short vertical words in the lower turn-in. Possibly nothing substantive.
image-021: left = 4r, right = 3r.
  4r: heading "Michl Ferg"(?) centred at top; ca. 18 written lines; entries with amounts; two "Suma"; final 4 lines in a different (lighter) layout, an added note; lower half blank.
  3r: running heading "Sagmaister"(?) at top; a dated paragraph "Anno 1538 ..." then amounts; ca. 12 lines; lower half blank and stained.
image-031: left = 4v, right = 3v.
  4v: heading 2 lines ("Michl Salgeber ... zu ..."), grain account (Mutt Roggen / Gersten) ca. 30 lines with Suma lines; additions at the foot.
  3v: heading at top; long dated paragraph "Anno 1538 den 8 tag Octobris ..." ca. 25 lines with amounts and Suma; marginal note at left (ca. 4 lines) beside the paragraph.

Tile mapping: 002-010 = 3x3 grid on image-001 (rows 002-004, 005-007, 008-010); 012-020 = 3x3 on image-011; 022-030 = 3x3 on image-021; 032-043 = 4x3 grid on image-031 (rows 032-035, 036-039, 040-043). Tiles overlap.

Abbreviation conventions used below: fl = florin sign (written ff with stroke), k = kreuzer, Suma with flourished S; "Itm" for Item; superscript marks retained as ' where seen. Numbers as written.

TRANSCRIPTIONS (per tile, line numbers counted from top of each image)

=== FACE 2r (image-001 left; tiles 002-010) ===
Note: the entry word read "Itm" below is a Kurrent "Item" form (looks like "Agr"/"Ayer"); expanded Itm = Item.

image-002 (top-left of 2r; top edge torn; text at right cut by tile edge)
002.01 (right edge) [leader] 4 ff[...]   (amount line, continues on 003)
002.02 [...]hns(?) vmb 7 ogen(?) brein(?) von jm
002.03 [first letters lost at turned edge] [leader] 51 [...]   (fold/crease below, paper torn along fold)
002.04 [tape] 10 1/2 lb(?) schmaltz 1 ff 13 k fur(?)   (the 'lb' sign is a looped h/lb)
002.05 jm vom [tape] kaß(?) (superscript o over a: "käß"?) 1 ff 9 k thuet [leader] 7 ff[...]
002.06 Itm sol man(?) [crease] jm für ain fuer(?) [leader] 1 [...]
002.07 Itm mer(?) gibt(?) [crease] jm für den drosse(?) koß(?) [leader] 36 [...]
002.08 Suma (flourished S) — 76(?) ff 46 k 1 f(?) 2[...]
   (tile ends with top of a large flourished initial at lower left)

image-003 (top-centre; overlaps 002 at left; shows right edge of 2r and left edge of 1r)

003.01 [leader] 4 ff 21 k            (= 002.01)
003.02 ... von jm                    (end of 002.02)
003.03 [leader] 51 ff 70(?) k         (= 002.03; '70' perhaps '30')
003.04 ... 3 k fare(?)               (end of 002.04)
003.05 [leader] ii ff 43 k i f(?) 2   (right of 002.04/05; written above 7 ff line; "ii" or "11")
003.06 [leader] 7 ff . 30 kr          (= 002.05)
003.07 [leader] 1 ff                  (= 002.06)
003.08 [leader] 36 k                  (= 002.07)
003.09 ...46 k ij(?) 1 f(?) 2 pure(?) / "per" (end of Suma line 002.08; last word ends with p-loop, perhaps "puru" / "perner")
 1r left edge (right part of tile):
003.r1 [...]ß(?)               (top of large initial / heading fragment)
003.r2 [...]gerait(?)
003.r3 [...] vnnd(?)
003.r4 [...]en. So(?) [...]
003.r5 [leader] 6 [...]
003.r6 [...] vns. von(?) Rogge[n?] / von logge(?) [...]
003.r7 [leader]
003.r8 Suma
003.r9 [D?]undtregen(?) soll(?) wir [...]
003.r10 weissen(?) vardinger(?) / weisses verdinger(?)

=== FACE 1r (image-001 right; tiles 003 right part, 004, 006-007, 009-010) ===
image-004 (top-right of 1r; left edge overlaps 003 right part)
004.01 [heading, left part lost/cut] ...ferg            (top right corner: number "92" in same/similar ink, folio or page number)
004.02 [...]gerait . am 12 Septembris
004.03 [...] vnns schuldig . vmb 100 st(?) [ "100st" - perhaps "1005" or "100 ster"]
004.04 [...]en . So wir jm zu(?) j ster(?) p(er?) 4 kr
004.05 [leader] 6 ff 40 kr
   (fold)
004.06 [...]er(?) . von loggen(?) Sigmund Ostlnis(?) / Östlins(?)   (initial-like long-stemmed letter before the name)
004.07 [leader] j ff 12 kr
004.08 Suma [leader] 7 ff 52 kr
004.09 [...] sollen wir jm . für j stuckh
004.10 [...]rdlinger [leader] 7 ff 30 kr
Combined with 003.r9-10: "[D?]undtregen(?) sollen wir jm . für j stuckh / weissen(?) Nördlinger(?) — 7 ff 30 kr"  (the reading "Nördlinger" is from the letters "...rdlinger" plus "v/n..." at line start on 003; uncertain)

=== FACE 2r continued ===
image-005 (middle-left of 2r; first two lines overlap 002.07-08)
005.01 Itm mer(?) gibt(?) jm für den drosse(?) koß(?) [leader] 36[...]   (= 002.07)
005.02 Suma — 76 ff 46 k i(j?) f 2[...]                                   (= 002.08)
005.03 Dargegen soll vns Hen[...]ysl(?) / "Heinrich(?)" sein zinß vom      (large flourished D initial)
005.04 1538 Jar [leader] 18 [ff]

005.06 alten st[...] [hole] [leader] 2 [ff ...]
005.07 Itm von hern Bastian auf das Schmaltz em=
